title: Training Log Merge
user: Recreational athletes mixing gym plans with running or wearable workouts who need one private weekly training view without forcing all activity into a single app.
current_workaround: Switch among Strava, a strength app, a watch dashboard, spreadsheets, and chat-based accountability.
smallest_useful_product: Offline importer for simple CSV/GPX workout exports plus manual strength sessions; display a weekly timeline and user-set session labels/load notes, with CSV export.
